selection_principle: Select by Creative Fit/customer decision logic. Apply Production Feasibility only after fit is determined.

families.name: Clinical Calm / Structured Reassurance
avoid_when: page requires strong expressive aspiration before comprehension

families.name: Editorial High-Consideration / Aspirational Authority
creative_fit_signals: desire and rational proof both material
avoid_when: premium signal would rely only on giant type/luxury imagery

families.name: Proof-Led Process Authority
avoid_when: proof is too weak and would require invented process

families.name: Local Human / Community Warmth
avoid_when: locality is only a geographic fact and not a decision factor

families.name: Category Education / Open Discovery
avoid_when: category already understood and explanation would slow conversion

overlap_rule: A company may fit multiple families. Dominant family and secondary influence may coexist; do not force one-hot classification.
validation_requirement: Multi-company validation is required before any family becomes a production-selectable contract.
